Earthworm Jim 2 Widescreen 16:9 (partial)

Shows gameplay at 16:9 with real extra view on both sides: the game draws the
wider area (nothing is stretched) and the HUD moves to the screen corners,
keeping the distance to the edge it had in 4:3.

Partial: Puppy Love 1-3, Flyin' King and Lorenzo's Soil keep their original
4:3, as do menus, transition screens, videos and the ending. Disable the
feature on the launcher's Mods page to play everything in the original 4:3.
